about: Opponent PROFILE rows (Strategy 2026-10-27; the donor pattern of AzerothCore creature_template and EQEmu npc_types): the unit a fight is built from. A row names who he is (`opponent`: a V1 roster id, src/fight/moves.ts OPPONENTS), the body he is drawn in (`body`, below), the brain laid over his V1 AI profile (`brain`: a data/brains.json row id, or null = V1's profile as it is) and his stat scales at 100 % (foeHealthScale, foeDamageScale; a difficulty row's scales multiply these). A difficulty row (data/difficulty.json) overrides the brain knobs and scales on top of one profile. `body` (Dom 2026-10-27: 'switch in a different boss with one or two lines'): the Mixamo 106 body the profile is drawn in, a key of data/rig.json `files` (a 65 body stem) whose 106 file also has a data/rig.json clips106.dir folder; a row with none gets `defaultBody` (the Minotaur, today's boss). src/fight/foe-body.ts reads it; src/sim/validate.js checkBodies rejects an unknown or clip-less body (and src/fight/foe-body.ts throws at load on the same check); ?<bodyQuery>=<body> (?boss=<body>) swaps the body for one page view (a preview flag, the default row unchanged). A boss cannot be drawn in the hero's body (Psyche): the page shares one loaded rig between two actors of one file and a shared rig carries one weapon, so the check rejects it. One body per opponent id: two profiles on one `opponent` cannot name different bodies. Which bodies are drop-in today, and what a new one needs: docs/BOSS-BODIES.md. The weapon and specials are still V1's rows for `opponent` (the Pitborn's cleaver and Earth Fold). The fight config is { profile id, difficulty row id } (data/fight.json `profile`, data/difficulty.json `default`, ?difficulty=): plain data, deterministic, so a server can choose both per encounter. PvP uses neither. PER-SPAWN KIND (Strategy + Dom 2026-10-27, 'build it once'): a zone spawn row's `kind` (data/zones/*.row.json spawns[].kind) is a profile `id` here; when the sim is handed to that spawn (or it joins as an attacker) the fight is built from this row: the `opponent` archetype's stats, moves and specials, the difficulty row's brain knobs and scales times this row's, and the row's optional `knobs` (a partial set of the nine brain knobs, laid OVER the difficulty row's: a goblin that dodges and weaves whatever the ladder says; none = the difficulty row alone). src/fight/spawn-kind.ts builds it; src/sim/validate.js checkKinds checks it. A new boss is one row here, one spawn row there.

profiles.about: The level-18 Pitborn (V3's Minotaur): V1's cleaver, stats and class special; his skill knobs come from the difficulty row (brain null = V1's own for anything a row leaves out: spamRun 6).

Zone boss 2 (Dom 2026-10-28): the Gargantua. THE NUMBER DOM TUNES ON HIS PHONE IS foeHealthScale, first on this row: V1's executioner is 160 hp; x5.2 x the default difficulty row 5's own 0.72 = ~600 hp (599) at the DEFAULT pick Dom plays (at ladder scale 1 / legacy he is 832). Name, brain and damage are the executioner's own. Body: `gargantua` (OpenTrident's 106 body) once its data/rig.json files + clips106 rows land; until then he is drawn in `defaultBody` (docs/BOSS-BODIES.md). Revert: delete this row and the zone spawn that names it.
